d68_correction.rationale: D67 leaves hard termination / forced kill / native abort UNRESOLVED.  Such a termination can occur after entering (or during) a write region but before any durable artifact/stdout appears; therefore absence of RESULT/FAILURE/stdout does NOT prove the write regions were never entered.
enumeration_of_unexcluded_scenarios: termination after entering the result-write region but before durable RESULT creation
termination during the RESULT write before a FAILURE handler completes
termination after entering the FAILURE-write path but before durable FAILURE creation
termination during the FAILURE write before any stdout diagnostic is emitted

result_write_attempt.d68_rationale: A hard termination could occur AFTER entering the result-write region but BEFORE durable RESULT creation, or DURING the RESULT write before a FAILURE handler completes; absence of RESULT/FAILURE/stdout does NOT prove the region was never entered.

failure_write_attempt.d68_rationale: A hard termination could occur AFTER entering the FAILURE-write path but BEFORE durable FAILURE creation, or DURING the FAILURE write before any stdout diagnostic is emitted; absence of FAILURE/stdout does NOT prove the path was never entered.

scope_correction.note: D67 `prohibitions_observed` applies to the STATIC D67 ADJUDICATION OPERATION and must NOT be read as proof that the consumed v1.3 attempt avoided models / checkpoints / VAL images / intermediate stages.
